title: Egg Qorma
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Cooking oil 4 tbs or as required
Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 tbs
Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) 1 tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: In frying pan,add sesame seeds,poppy seed and roast until fragrant & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein safeed til aur kashkhash dal dein aur khushbu anay tak roast ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In the same frying pan,add tomatoes and roast for 2-3 minutes & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Us he frying pan mein tamatar dal dein aur 2-3 minutes kliya roast karein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add cooking oil,onion and fry until golden brown & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein cooing oil aur pyaz dal ker golden brown hunay tak fry ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In grinder,add fried onion,roasted tomatoes,roasted sesame & poppy seeds and grind well.
steps.romanUrdu: Grinder mein fried pyaz,roasted tamatar aur roasted safeed til aur kashkhash dal ker ache tarhan grind ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add water and grind to make a paste & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani dal dein aur grind ker ka paste tayyar ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In the same pot,heat cooking oil,add potatoes and fry until light golden.
steps.romanUrdu: Us he pot mein cooking oil garam karein aur aloo dal ker light golden hunay tak fry ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add eggs,fry until light golden and take out for later use.
steps.romanUrdu: Anday dal dein aur light golden hunay tak fry karein aur bad mein use kerna kliya bahir nikal lein.

steps.instruction: Add bay leaves,cumin seeds,cloves,green cardamom,green chilies and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Tez paat,zeera,laung,hari elaichi aur hari mirch dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add ginger garlic paste,mix well and cook for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak lehsan paste dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 2 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Now add grinded paste,mix well and cook for 4-5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab grinded paste shamil karein aur 4-5 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add red chili powder,coriander powder and salt,mix well and cook for 5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Lal mirch powder,dhania powder aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 5 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add water and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani shamil karein aur ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add garam masala powder and mix.
steps.romanUrdu: Garam masala powder dal ker mix karein.

steps.instruction: Cover and cook on low flame for 2-3 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Dhak dein aur halki ancch per 2-3 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Now add boiled & fried eggs and mix gently.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab boiled & fried anday dal ker gently mix karein.

steps.instruction: Sprinkle mint leaves & serve.
steps.romanUrdu: Podina dal ker mix karein.

title: Qeema Naan
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 tsp
Lal mirch (Red chili) crushed 1 tsp or to taste
Namak (Salt) ½ tsp or to taste
Hara dhania (Fresh coriander) chopped ½ Cup

steps.instruction: In chopper,add beef mince and chop well.
steps.romanUrdu: Chopper mein qeema dal ker ache tarhan chop ker lein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add beef mince,ginger garlic paste,cumin seeds,coriander seeds,red chili crushed,garam masala powder,salt,green chilies,onion,garlic,fresh coriander,mix well and set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein beef qeema,adrak lehsan paste,zeera,dhania,lal mirch crushed,garam masala powder, namak,hari mirch,pyaz,lehsan aur hara dhania dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In small jug,add milk,water and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Chotay jug mein doodh aur pani dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add all-purpose flour,sugar,baking powder,instant yeast,salt and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein maida,cheeni,baking powder,khameer aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add oil and egg,mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Oil aur anda shamil karein aur ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add milk+ water,mix well and knead until soft dough is formed.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka doodh+pani dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur ghond ker naram dough tayyar ker lein.

steps.instruction: Cover and let it rest for 1 & ½ hours.
steps.romanUrdu: Dhak ker 1 & ½ hours kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Knead dough again,sprinkle all-purpose flour and knead until smooth.
steps.romanUrdu: Dough ko dubara ghond lein,maida chirak lein aur smooth hunay tak ghond lein.

steps.instruction: Divide dough into 3 equal pieces.
steps.romanUrdu: Dough ko 3 equal pieces mein divide ker lein.

steps.instruction: Take a small dough,make a ball and flatten the ball with the help of the hands.
steps.romanUrdu: Chota dough lein aur ball bana lein aur haathon ki madad sa ball ko flat ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add mince stuffing in the center and pull the edges up,seal and shape again into a ball.
steps.romanUrdu: Qeema stuffing rakh dein aur edges ko pull ker ka seal ker lein aur dubara ball ki shape bana lein.

steps.instruction: Sprinkle all-purpose flour and roll out with the help of rolling pin.
steps.romanUrdu: Maida chirak dein aur rolling pin ki madad sa bail lein.

steps.instruction: Brush the top with milk,sprinkle sesame seeds and add marks with the help of the hands.
steps.romanUrdu: Naan ka upper doodh laga ker til chirak dein aur haathon ki madad sa marks laga lein.

steps.instruction: Now transfer the naan to the foiled baking tray and bake in preheated at 180 C for 30-35 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab naan ko foiled baking tray per rakh dein aur preheated oven mein 180 C per 30-35 minutes kliya bake ker lein.

steps.instruction: After baking,brush the top with butter and cut into four pieces and serve.
steps.romanUrdu: Baking ka bad naan ka upper makhan laga aur aur 4 pieces mein cut ker ka serve karein.

ogDescription: A must try Homemade Qeema Naan Recipe for you today. Make it, eat it, share it and enjoy it. #HappyCookingToYou

title: Chana Pulao
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Sabut kali mirch (Black peppercorns) ½ tsp
Namak (Salt) 1 & ½ tsp or to taste
Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) 1 tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: In spice mixer,add nutmeg,mace,black peppercorns,black cardamom and grind well.
steps.romanUrdu: Spice mixer mein jaifil,javatri,sabut kali mirch aur badi elaichi dal ker ache tarhan grind karein.

steps.instruction: Add ginger,garlic,green chilies,water and grind to make a paste & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak,lehsan,hari mirch aur pani dal dein aur grind ker ka paste tayyar ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add cooking oil,onion and fry until light golden.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein cooking oil aur pyaz dal dein aur light golden hunay tak fry ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add cumin seeds,cinnamon sticks,black peppercorns,cloves,green cardamom and mix.
steps.romanUrdu: Zeera,darchini,sabut kali mirch,laung aur hari elaichi dal ker mix karein.

steps.instruction: Now add grinded paste and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab grinded paste shamil karein aur ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add salt,red chili powder and mix well for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Namak aur lal mirch powder dal ker 2 minutes kliya ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add yogurt and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Dahi shamil karein aur ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add chicken stock cube,mint leaves and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Chicken stock cube aur podina dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add water,mix well and bring it to boil.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani dal dein aur ubal anay dein.

steps.instruction: Add chickpeas and rice,mix gently and bring it to boil.
steps.romanUrdu: Chanay aur chawal dal ker gently mix ker lein aur ubal anay dein.

steps.instruction: Cook on medium high flame until water is reduced (8-10 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: Darmiyani tez ancch per pani reduce ho janay tak paka lein (8-10 minutes).

steps.instruction: Cover and steam cook on low flame for 5-8 minutes & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Dhak dein aur halki ancch per 5-8 minutes kliya steam cook ker lein & serve karein.

title: Fish Tikka

Namak (Salt) ½ tsp or to taste
Zarda ka rang (Yellow food color) ¼ tsp or as required
Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 tbs
Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 tbs
Namak (Salt) ½ tsp or to taste
Lal mirch (Red chili) crushed ½ tsp or to taste
Safed mirch powder (White pepper powder) ½ tsp
Kali mirch powder (Black pepper powder) ½ tsp

steps.instruction: In bowl,add red chili powder,coriander powder,garam masala powder,cumin seeds,salt,yellow food color,lemon juice,ginger garlic paste and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein lal mirch powder,dhania powder,garam masala powder,zeera,namak,zarda ka rang,lemon juice aur adrak lehsan paste dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add fish boneless cubes and prepared paste,mix well and marinate for 30 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein fish boneless cubes aur tayyar paste dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 30 minutes kliya matinate ker lein.

steps.instruction: Thread lemon slices and marinated fish cubes on skewers.
steps.romanUrdu: Lemon slices aur marinated machli ko skewers per laga lein.

steps.instruction: In grill pan,add oil and fry on low flame until done.
steps.romanUrdu: Grill pan mein oil dal dein aur fish ko pak janay tak halki ancch per fry ker lein.

steps.instruction: Switch off the flame and give a charcoal smoke for 2 minutes & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Chulha bund ker dein aur 2 minutes kliya koyla ka dhuwan dein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In wok,add oil,ginger garlic paste and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein oil aur adrak lehsan paste dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add tomatoes,mix well and cook for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Tamatar dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 2 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add salt,red chili crushed,white pepper powder,black pepper powder,coriander powder,cumin seeds and mix well,cook until tomatoes are soft.
steps.romanUrdu: Namak,lal mirch crushed,safed mirch powder,kali mirch powder,dhania powder aur zeera dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur tamatar naram hunay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add grilled fish cubes,ginger and green chilies,cover and simmer for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Grilled fish cubes,adrak aur hari mirch dal dein aur dhak ker 2 minutes kliya dum per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Garnish with green chili and ginger & serve.
steps.romanUrdu: Hari mirch aur adrak sa granish ker ka serve karein.

title: Aamras Puri
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Mong daal (Yellow lentil) ½ Cup (soaked for 2 hours)
Namak (Salt) ½ tsp or to taste
Zeera (Cumin seeds) roasted & crushed ½ tsp
Sabut dhania (Coriander seeds) crushed ½ tsp
Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 tsp
Lal mirch powder (Red chilli powder) ½ tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: In a blender jug,add mangoes,sugar,cardamom powder and milk,blend to make puree & refrigerate until serve.
steps.romanUrdu: Blender jug mein aam,cheeni,elaichi powder aur doodh dal dein aur ache tarhan blend ker ka puree tayyar ker lein & serve kernay tak refrigerate ker lein.

steps.instruction: In a saucepan,add yellow lentil,salt,water,mix well & bring it to boil.
steps.romanUrdu: Saucepan mein moong daal,namak aur pani dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur ubal anay dein.

steps.instruction: Remove scum,cover & cook on low flame until tender & dries up (approx. 14-15 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: Scum ko nikal lein aur dhak ker halki ancch per daal gul janay aur sukh janay tak paka lein (approx. 14-15 minutes).

steps.instruction: Let it cool.
steps.romanUrdu: Thanda ker lein.

steps.instruction: In chopper,add boiled lentil,green chillies,fresh coriander,chop coarsely & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Chopper mein boiled daal,hari mirchein aur hara dhania dal ker coarsely chop ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In a frying pan,add cooking oil,carom seeds,cumin seeds,coriander seeds & mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein cooking oil,ajwain,zeera aur sabut dhania dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add ginger garlic paste,turmeric powder,red chilli powder & mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak lehsan paste,haldi powder aur lal mirch powder dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Now add chopped lentil mixture and mix well,cook for a minute & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab chopped daal mixture dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur ek minute kliya paka lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add all-purpose flour,semolina,salt,ghee & mix well until crumbled.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein maida,soji,namak aur ghee dal dein aur crumble hunay tak ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add water & knead until dough is formed,cover & let it rest for 25-30 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur ghond ker dough tayyar ker lein aur dhak ker 25-30 minutes kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Grease hands with oil and knead dough again until smooth.
steps.romanUrdu: Haathon ko oil sa grease karein aur dough ko smooth hunay tak dubara ghond lein.

steps.instruction: Take a small dough (50g),make a ball & spread with the help of hands.
steps.romanUrdu: Chota dough lein (50g),ball bana lein aur haathon ki madad sa pheela lein.

steps.instruction: Add small quantity (2 tsp) of lentil mixture in the center of the dough then gather all the edges,pinch and seal to make a ball,pinch,press gently & roll out with the help of rolling pin (makes 11-12).
steps.romanUrdu: Daal mixture ki small quantity (2 tsp) ko dough ka center mein dal dein aur edges ko gather ker lein,pinch aur seal ker ka ball bana lein,gently press karein aur rolling pin ki madad sa bail lein (makes 11-12).

steps.instruction: In a wok,heat cooking oil & fry puri on low flame from both sides until golden & crispy while frying gently press so that it may puffs up.
steps.romanUrdu: Karahi mein cooking oil garam karein aur halki ancch per dono sides sa golden & crispy hunay tak fry ker lein aur frying kertay hoye gently press kertay rahein tak puri phool jaye.

steps.instruction: Serve puris with aam ras.
steps.romanUrdu: Puris ko aam ras ka saath serve karein.

ogDescription: This mango season try Aamras puri and share with friends and family. #HappyCookingToYou #FoodFusion

title: Arvi Gosht
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 tbs
Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) 1 tsp or to taste
Pani (Water) 1 & ½ Cups or as required

steps.instruction: Peel,cut and wash taro roots properly.
steps.romanUrdu: Arvi ko cheel ker bech mein sa cut laga lein aur ache tarhan dho lein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add water,taro roots and salt,mix and let it rest for 1 hour then strain & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein pani,arvi aur namak dal ker mix karein aur 1 hour kliya chor dein phir strain ker ka side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In grinder,add onion,tomato,ginger and water,grind well & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Grinder mein pyaz,tamatar,adrak aur pani dal ker ache tarhan grind karein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In grinder,add yogurt,fried onion,grind well & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Grinder mein dahi aur fried pyaz dal ker ache tarhan grind karein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add cooking oil,mutton mix boti and mix well until changes color.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein cooking oil aur mutton mix boti dal dein aur rang tabdeel hunay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add ginger garlic paste and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak lehsan paste dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add salt,red chili powder,turmeric powder and coriander powder,mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Namak,lal mirch powder,haldee powder aur dhania powder dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 2-3 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add grinded tomato & onion paste,mix well and cook until oil separates.
steps.romanUrdu: Grinded tamatar & onion paste dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur oil alag hunay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add water,mix well and bring it to boil,cover and cook until meat is 3/4th done (25-30 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: Pani dal ker mix karein aur ubal anay dein aur dhak ker gosht 3/4th done ho janay tak paka lein (25-30 minutes).

steps.instruction: Now add grinded yogurt paste and mix well for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab grinded dahi ka paste dal ker 2 minutes kliya ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add taro roots and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Arvi shamil karein aur ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add water and mix well,cover and cook on low flame until taro roots & meat are tender (18-20 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: Pani dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur dhak ker halki ancch per arvi aur gosht gul janay tak paka lein (18-20 minutes).

steps.instruction: Add garam masala powder and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Garam masala powder dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add ginger,green chili,fresh coriander and mix,cover and simmer for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak,hari mirch aur hara dhania dal ker mix karein aur dhak ker 2 minutes kliya dum per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Garnish with ginger,fresh coriander & serve.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak aur hara dhania sa garnish ker ka serve karein.

steps.instruction: Take a small dough & make a ball,dust dry flour & roll out with the help of rolling pin and prick with fork (makes 15).

steps.instruction: Fold taco in half & hold and cook for 30 seconds.

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add fish boneless cubes,cumin powder,red chilli powder,salt,black pepper powder and lemon juice,mix well and marinate for 15 minutes.

steps.instruction: In a frying pan,add cooking oil and cook marinated fish for 3-4 minutes or until dries up & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein cooking oil dal dein aur marinated fish ko 3-4 minutes ya pani sukh janay tak paka lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add cream,lemon juice & whisk well.

steps.instruction: Add milk,whisk well and rest it for 15 minutes.Sour cream is ready!

title: Mini Pizza
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 tsp
Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) ½ tsp or to taste
Kali mirch powder (Black pepper powder) ½ tsp
Namak (Salt) ½ tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: In small jug,add instant yeast,sugar,warm water and mix well,cover and let it rest for 15 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Chotay jug mein khameer,cheeni aur neem garam pani dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur dhak ker 15 minutes kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In all-purpose flour,add salt,oil and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Maida mein namak aur oil dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Now add yeast mixture and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab khameer ka mixture dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add warm water and knead until dough is formed,cover and let it rest for 2-3 hours.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka neem garam pani shamil karein aur ghond ker dough tayyar ker lein aur dhak ker 2-3 hours kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Grease your hands with oil and knead dough again until smooth.Dough is ready.
steps.romanUrdu: Haathon ko oil sa grease karein aur dough ko smooth hunay tak dubara ghond lein.Dough tayyar hai.

steps.instruction: In chicken boneless cubes,add yogurt,ginger garlic paste,lemon juice,red chili powder,coriander powder,garam masala powder,turmeric powder,black pepper powder and salt,mix well and marinate for 30 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Chicken boneless mein dahi,adrak lehsan paste,lemon juice,lal mirch powder,dhania powder,garam masala powder,haldee powder,kali mirch powder aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 30 minutes kliya marinate ker lein.

steps.instruction: In frying pan,add oil and marinated chicken and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein oil aur marinated chicken dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Cover and cook on low flame for 8-10 minutes then cook on high flame until its dry.
steps.romanUrdu: Dhak dein aur halki ancch per 8-10 minutes kliya paka lein phir tez ancch per pani sukh janay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: You can use leftover chicken or chicken chunks.
steps.romanUrdu: Leftover chicken or chcekn chunks bhi use ker saktay han.

steps.instruction: Take a small dough and make a ball,on pizza tray,spinkle flour and press to make a flat dough and prick with fork.
steps.romanUrdu: Chota dough lein aur ball bana lein,pizza pan mein maida chirak dein aur dough ko press ker ka flat ker lein aur fork ki madad sa prick ker lein.

steps.instruction: Spread pizza sauce,add cooked chicken,onion,cheddar cheese,capsicum,mozzarella cheese,black olives and dried oregano.
steps.romanUrdu: Pizza sauce dal ker pheela lein,cooked chicken,pyaz,cheddar cheese,shimla mirch,mozzarella cheese, black olives aur dried oregano dal dein.

steps.instruction: Cover and can be freeze for up to 1 week then thaw before baking (makes 6-7 mini pizzas).
steps.romanUrdu: Dhak dein aur 1 week kliya freeze ker saktay han phir thaw ker ka bake karein (makes 6-7 mini pizzas).

steps.instruction: Option no.1: Without Oven:
steps.romanUrdu: Option no.1: Without Oven:

steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein zeera powder,paprika powder,jaifil powder,dhania powder,lal mirch powder aur kali mirch crushed dal ker ache tarhan mix karein & side per rakhd ein.

steps.instruction: In grinder,add tomatoes and grind to make a puree & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Grinder mein tamatar dal dein aur grind ker ka puree tayyar ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In saucepan,add cooking oil,onion and sauté until translucent.
steps.romanUrdu: Saucepan mein cooking oil aur pyaz dal dein aur translucent hunay tak sauté ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add garlic and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Lehsan dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Now add 2 tbs of prepared spice mix,salt,cinnamon stick,bay leaves and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: 2 tbs tayyar spice mix,namak,darchini aur tez paat dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add tomato puree,mix well and cook for 4-5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Tamatar puree dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 4-5 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add vinegar,red chili crushed and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Sirka aur lal mirch crushed dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add water and mix,cover and cook on low flame for 10-15 minutes & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani dal ker mix karein aur dhak ker halki ancch per 10-15 minutes kliya paka lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add cooking oil,rice,mix well and cook for 5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein cooking oil aur chawal dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 5 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add remaining spice mix and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Remaining spice mix dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add water,salt,mix well and bring it to boil and cook on medium flame until water is reduced.

steps.instruction: Cover and steam cook on low flame for 5-6 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Dhak dein aur halki ancch per 5-6 minutes kliya steam cook ker lein.

steps.instruction: In serving plate,add cooked rice,boiled whole black lentil gram,boiled macaroni,boiled chickpeas, prepared tomato sauce,fried onion & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Serving plate mein cooked chawal,boiled sabut kali masoor daal,boiled macaroni,boiled chanay,tayyar tomato sauce aur fried pyaz dal ker serve karein.

title: Saag Gosht
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Sarson ka saag (Fresh mustard leaves) 2 kg
Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 & ½ tbs
Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) 1 tbs or to taste

steps.instruction: Clean all the fresh mustard leaves and wash them thoroughly.
steps.romanUrdu: Sarson ka saag ko ache tarhan pani sa dho lein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add water and bring it to boil.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein pani dal ker ubal lein.

steps.instruction: Add fresh mustard leaves,green chilies,mix and bring it to boil,cover and boil on medium low flame for 4-5 hours (grind if desired) & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Sarson ka saag aur hari mirch dal ker mix karein aur ubal anay dein phir dhak ker halki darmiyani ancch per 4-5 hours kliya boil ker lein (agar zaroorat ho tou grind ker lein) & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add mustard oil,cloves,cinnamon sticks,whole black pepper,green cardamom,black cardamom, cumin seeds and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein sarson ka tail,laung,darchini,sabut kali mirch,hari elaichi,badi elaichi aur zeera dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add beef boneless cubes and mix well until changes color.
steps.romanUrdu: Beef boneless cubes dal dein aur rang tabdeel hunay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add onion,mix well and cook for 10-12 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Pyaz dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 10-12 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add ginger garlic paste and mix well for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak lehsan paste dal ker 2 minutes kliya ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add coriander powder,turmeric powder,red chili powder,salt,mix well and cook for 5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Dhania powder,haldee powder,lal mirch powder aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein aur 5 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add water,mix well and bring it to boil,cover and cook on low flame for 25-30 minutes or until meat is tender.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani dal ker mix karein aur ubal anay ka bad dhak dein aur halki ancch per 25-30 minutes ya gosht gul janay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add tomatoes and mix well,cover and cook until tomatoes are soft and oil separates.
steps.romanUrdu: Tamatar dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur dhak ker tamatar naram hunay aur oil alag hunay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: Now add boiled fresh mustard leaves,mix well and cook for 8-10 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab boiled sarson ka saag dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 8-10 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add green garlic,green chili,fresh coriander and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Hara lehsan,hari mirch aur hara dhania dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Garnish with green chili,green garlic & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Hari mirch aur hara lehsan sa garnish ker ka serve karein.

title: Chap shoro
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.item: Chakki ka atta (Whole wheat flour) sifted
items.raw: Chakki ka atta (Whole wheat flour) sifted 2 & ½ Cup
Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 tbs
Zeera (Cumin seeds) roasted & crushed ½ tbs
Pani (Water) ½ Cup or as required

items.item: Hara dhania & Podina (Fresh coriander & Mint leaves) chopped
items.raw: Hara dhania & Podina (Fresh coriander & Mint leaves) chopped 2-3 tbs

items.item: Apricot or Walnut oil for frying or cooking oil of your choice
items.raw: Apricot or Walnut oil for frying or cooking oil of your choice

steps.instruction: In bowl,add add wheat flour,salt and mix.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein chakki ka atta aur namak dal ker mix karein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add water and knead until dough is formed,cover and let it rest for 15 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur ghond ker dough tayyar ker lein,dhak dein aur 15 minutes kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In frying pan,add apricot or walnut oil,onion and sauté until translucent.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein apricot or walnut oil aur pyaz dal dein aur translucent hunay tak sauté ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add chicken mince and mix well until changes color.
steps.romanUrdu: Chicken qeema dal ker rang tabdeel hunay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add ginger garlic paste and mix well for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak lehsan paste dal ker 2 minutes kliya ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add salt,cumin seeds,black pepper crushed and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Namak,zeera aur kali mirch crushed dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add tomato and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Tamatar dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add water and mix well,cover and cook on medium flame for 8-10 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur dhak ker darmiyani anacch per 8-10 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: In water,add saffron strands and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani mein zafran dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add dissolve saffron and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Dissolve zafran dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add onion,fresh coriander & mint leaves and mix well for 1-2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Pyaz,hara dhania & podina dal ker 1-2 minutes kliya ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Let it cool.
steps.romanUrdu: Thanda ker lein.

steps.instruction: Knead dough again,grease hands with oil,take a small dough and make a ball,sprinkle flour and roll out with the help of rolling pin.
steps.romanUrdu: Dough ko dubara ghond lein,haath ok oil sa grease karein aur chota dough la ker ball bana lein,atta chirak dein aur rolling pin ki madad sa bail lein.

steps.instruction: Sprinkle flour,fold & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Atta chirak dein aur fold ker ka side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Roll out another dough with the help of rolling pin.
steps.romanUrdu: Ek aur dough ko rolling pin ki madad sa bail lein.

steps.instruction: Add cooked chicken filling and spread evenly.
steps.romanUrdu: Cooked chicken filling dal ker pheela lein.

steps.instruction: Place rolled dough and prick with skewer,fold and seal the edges (makes 3).
steps.romanUrdu: Rolled dough rakh ker skewer sa prick ker lein aur edges ko fold ker ka seal ker lein (makes 3).

steps.instruction: Heat griddle and cooked rolled dough from both sides then fry in apricot or walnut oil & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Tawa garam karein aur rolled dough ko dono sides sa paka lein phir apricot or walnut oil mein fry ker lein & serve karein!

title: Mutanjan
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.note: (soaked & boiled with cloves 6,green cardamom 6,salt ½ tbs until ¾th done)
items.raw: Chawal (Rice) sella ½ kg (soaked & boiled with cloves 6,green cardamom 6,salt ½ tbs until ¾th done)
Yellow food color ½ tsp dissolve in 2 tbs water
Red food color ½ tsp dissolve in 2 tbs water
Green food color ½ tsp dissolve in 2 tbs water
Cheeni (Sugar) 1 & ½ Cups or to taste

steps.instruction: In 3 bowls,add ½ cup of boiled rice in each bowl.
steps.romanUrdu: 3 bowls mein ½ cup boiled chawal dal dein.

steps.instruction: Add yellow color,red color,green color,mix well & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Yellow color,red color aur green color dal ker ache tarhan mix ker karein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add butter and let it melt,add dried coconut,almonds,pistachio and fry for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein makhan dal ker melt karein,sukha narial,badam aur pista dal ker 2 minutes kliya fry ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add raisins and fry for 1 minute & take out in a bowl.
steps.romanUrdu: Kishmish dal ker 1 minute kliya fry ker lein & bowl mein niakl lein.

steps.instruction: Add sugar and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Cheeni dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add khoya,mix continuously and fry until brown and take out in a bowl.
steps.romanUrdu: Khoya dal ker musalsal mix kertay rahein aur brown hunay tak fry ker lein aur bowl mein nikal lein.

steps.instruction: In the same pot,add ghee and let it melt.
steps.romanUrdu: Us he pot mein ghee dal ker melt karein.

steps.instruction: Add cloves,green cardamom and mix.
steps.romanUrdu: Laung aur hari elaichi dal ker mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add sugar and milk,mix well and cook until sugar is dissolved.
steps.romanUrdu: Cheeni aur doodh shamil karein aur cheeni ghul janay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add lemon juice and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Lemon juice dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add remaining boiled rice and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Baqi boiled rice dal ker mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add half quantity of fried dry nuts and give it a good mix.
steps.romanUrdu: Fried dry nuts ki adhe quantity dal ker mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add kewra water,mix well and cook for 4-5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Kewra water dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 4-5 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add half quantity of fried khoya and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Fried khoya ki adhe quantity dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add fried khoya,green colored rice,red colored rice and yellow colored rice.
steps.romanUrdu: Fried khoya,green colored chawal,red colored chawal aur yellow colored chawal dal dein.

steps.instruction: Cover and simmer on low flame for 8-10 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Dhak dein aur 8-10 minutes kliya halki ancch per dum per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Garnish with fried khoya,fried dry nuts,gulab janum,cham cham & serve.
steps.romanUrdu: Fried khoya,fried dry nuts,gulab jamun aur cham cham sa garnish ker ka serve karein.

ogDescription: A festive dessert for a festive occasion. Make Mutanjan with our recipe and enjoy the sweetness of Eid. #HappyCookingToYou

title: Mango Cake
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Yellow food color 5-6 drops or as required
Mango puree 2 tbs or as required

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add all-purpose flour,salt,baking soda,baking powder,mix well & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein maida,namak,baking soda aur baking powder dal ker ache tarhan mix karein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Grease 9” baking pan with cooking oil,place butter paper the again grease with oil & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: 9” inch baking pan ko cooking oil sa grease karein aur butter paper laga ker dubara oil sa grease ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In milk,add vinegar,mix well & rest for 5 minutes.Buttermilk is ready!
steps.romanUrdu: Doodh mein sirka dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 5 minute kliya chor dein.Buttermilk tayyar hai.

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add eggs & beat until fluffy.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein anday dal dein aur fluffy hunay tak beat ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add yogurt,mango puree,prepared buttermilk,vanilla essence,caster sugar,cooking oil & beat well.
steps.romanUrdu: Dahi,mango puree,tayyar buttermilk,vanilla essence,bareek cheeni aur cooking oil dal ker ache tarhan beat ker lein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add dry ingredients & beat well.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka dry ingredients shamil karein aur ache tarhan beat ker lein.

steps.instruction: On greased baking pan,add prepared batter & bake in preheated oven at 170C for 35 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Greased baking pan mein tayyar batter dal dein aur preheated oven mein 170C per 35 minutes kliya bake ker lein.

steps.instruction: Take out from the oven & let it cool then remove butter paper.
steps.romanUrdu: Oven sa nikal ker thanda ker lein phir butter paper nikal lein.

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add whipping cream & beat well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein whipping cream dal ker ache tarhan beat ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add vanilla essence,powdered sugar & beat until soft peaks form.
steps.romanUrdu: Vanilla essence aur powdered sugar dal ker soft peaks form hunay tak beat ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add yellow food color and beat again,transfer to a piping bag & refrigerate until use.
steps.romanUrdu: Yellow food color dal ker dubara beat ker lein aur piping bag mein dal ker use kernay tak refrigerate ker lein.

steps.instruction: Trim a thin layer from the top of sponge cake with a serrated knife and then horizontally cut a layer of cake.
steps.romanUrdu: Sponge cake ki top layer ko serrated knife kki madad sa trim karein aur horizontally cake ki layer cut ker lein.

steps.instruction: On base of sponge cake,add & spread mango puree,prepared mango frosting,mango cubes,mango frosting & place top layer of cake over it & press gently.
steps.romanUrdu: Sponge cake ki base per mango puree aur mango frosting dal ker pheela lein aur mango cubes dal dein,mango frosting dal ker upper sa cake ki top layer rakh ker gently press ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add & spread mango frosting and frost the outside of the cake with mango frosting.
steps.romanUrdu: Mango frosting dal dein aur puray cake per mango frosting laga lein.

steps.instruction: Decorate cake with mango frosting & mango cubes
steps.romanUrdu: Mango frosting aur mango cubes sa decorate ker lein.

steps.instruction: Cut into slices & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Slices mein cut ker ka serve karein!

title: Aloo Chop

Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) ½ tsp
Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) ½ tsp or to taste

Hara dhania (Fresh coriander) chopped ½ Cup

steps.instruction: In bowl,add gram flour,carom seeds,coriander seeds,cumin powder,turmeric powder,red chili powder, baking soda,salt and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein besan,ajwain,dhania,zeera powder,haldee powder,lal mirch powder,baking soda aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Can be store in air tight container for up to 1 month at cool & dry place.
steps.romanUrdu: Air tight jar mein dal ker 1 month tak cool & dry place mein store ker saktay han.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add prepared pakora mix and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein tayyar pakora mix dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add garlic paste and gradually add water,mix well until well combined and let it rest for 30 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Lehsan paste dal dein aur thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur ache tarhan mix ker lein aur 30 minutes kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In frying pan,add oil,onion and fry until light brown.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein oil aur pyaz dal dein aur light brown hunay tak fry ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add ginger garlic paste,chaat masala,garam masala powder,red chili powder,salt and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak lehsan paste,chaat masala,garam masala powder,lal mirch powder aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add potato and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Aloo dal kr ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add fresh coriander and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Hara dhania dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Let it cool down.
steps.romanUrdu: Mixture ko thanda ker lein.

steps.instruction: Grease hands with oil,take a mixture and make a flat round balls and coat in prepared gram flour batter.
steps.romanUrdu: Haathon ko oil sa grease karein aur mixture ko lein aur flat round balls bana lein aur tayyar besan ka batter mein ache tarhan coat ker lein.

steps.instruction: In wok,heat cooking oil and fry until golden brown.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein oil garam karein aur golden brown hunay tak fry ker lein.

title: Kala Jamun
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: In a saucepan,add sugar,water,green cardamom and mix well,bring it to boil and cook until sugar is dissolved and cook on low flame until sugar turns sticky (4-5 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: Saucepan mein cheeni,pani aur hari elaichi dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur ubal anay ka bad cheeni ghul janay tak paka lein aur halki ancch per sheera sticky ho janay tak paka lein (4-5 minutes).

steps.instruction: Add lemon juice,mix well & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Lemon juice dal ker ache tarhan mix karein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add khoya,cottage cheese (crumble with the help of hand),all-purpose flour,semolina, cardamom powder,baking soda & mix until well combined.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein khoya,paneer (haath ki madad sa crumble ker lein),maida,sooji,elaichi powder aur baking soda dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a clean working surface,stretch & knead with the help of palm until dough is smooth (4-5 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: Mixture ko clean working surface per transfer ker lein aur haateli ki madad sa smooth dough tayyar hunay tak stretch & knead ker lein (4-5 minutes).

steps.instruction: Take a small quantity of dough (25g) and make balls of equal size.
steps.romanUrdu: Dough ki small quantity lein (25g) aur equal size ki balls bana lein.

steps.instruction: Take one ball and flatten,add mixed nuts and mix until well combined and make small ball for stuffing.
steps.romanUrdu: Ek ball la ker flat ker lein aur mixed nuts dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein aur stuffing kliya small balls bana lein.

steps.instruction: Take another plain dough,make a ball and flatten it on your palm and stuffed with mixed nuts ball then seal and pinch the dough roll between your palm to form a smooth oval ball (makes 9-10).
steps.romanUrdu: Plain dough ki ball lein aur haateli per flat ker lein,mixed nuts stuffed ball lein aur dough per rakh ker seal aur pinch ker lein aur smooth oval ball tayyar ker lein (makes 9-10).

steps.instruction: In a wok,add ghee & let it melt until medium hot.
steps.romanUrdu: Karahi mein ghee dal ker medium hot ho janay tak melt ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add prepared jamuns & fry on low flame from evenly until dark brown (6-7 minutes) and stir gently while frying.
steps.romanUrdu: Tayyar jamuns dal dein aur halki ancch per evenly dark brown ho janay tak fry ker lein (6-7 minutes) aur frying kertay hoye gently stir ker lein.

steps.instruction: Transfer fried jamuns in a deep dish & pour warm sugar syrup and let them soak in the sugar syrup for 4-5 hours.
steps.romanUrdu: Deep dish bowl mein fried jamuns dal dein aur upper sa warm sheera dal ker 4-5 hours kliya soak ker lein.

steps.instruction: Garnish with edible silver leaf, desiccated coconut, pistachio & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Chandi warq,khopra aur pista sa garnish ker ka serve karein!

steps.instruction: Sugar syrup can be stored in a refrigerator for up to 1 month and can be reusable.
steps.romanUrdu: Sheera 1 month kliya refrigerator mein store ker saktay han aur dubara use bhi ho sakta hai.

steps.instruction: Left over sugar syrup can be used in:
steps.romanUrdu: Left over sheer use ho sakta hai:

Namak (Salt) ½ tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: Gradually add water and mix well to make a thick paste.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur mix ker ka garha paste tayyar ker lein.

steps.instruction: Spread prepared paste,sprinkle dried pomegranate seeds and green gram.
steps.romanUrdu: Prepared paste ko dal ker pheela lein,anardana aur hari moong daal dal dein.

title: Malai Cake
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Bareek cheeni (Caster sugar) 3/4 Cup or to taste

steps.instruction: In a wok,add milk & bring it to boil.
steps.romanUrdu: Karahi mein doodh dal ker ubal lein.

steps.instruction: Add cardamom powder and condensed milk,mix well & cook on medium flame until it reduces to half quantity and keep mixing in between.
steps.romanUrdu: Elaichi powder aur condensed milk dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur darmiyani ancch per adhe quantity reh janay tak paka lein aur bech bech mein chamcha chalatay rahein.

steps.instruction: On low flame,add olper’s cream,whisk well and cook until it slightly thickens (approx. 2-3 minutes) & let it cool.
steps.romanUrdu: Chulha halka karein aur olper’s cream dal ker ache tarhan whisk ker lein aur slightly garha ho janay tak paka lein (approx. 2-3 minutes) & thanda ker lein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add eggs,caster sugar and beat well (approx. 2-3 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein anday aur bareek cheeni dal ker ache tarhan beat ker lein (approx. 3 minutes).

steps.instruction: Add vanilla essence,baking powder,cooking oil and beat for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Vanilla essence,baking powder aur cooking oil dal dein aur 2 minute kliya beat karein.

steps.instruction: Add semolina,all-purpose flour and beat again.
steps.romanUrdu: Soji aur maida dal dein aur dubara beat ker lein.

steps.instruction: Grease baking dish with cooking oil and pour prepared batter.

steps.instruction: Bake in preheated oven at 170 C for 30-35 minutes.

steps.instruction: Take out cake from oven & let it cool completely.

steps.instruction: Using a wooden skewer,poke holes all over the top of the cake.

steps.instruction: Slowly pour prepared milk malai syrup over the top of the cake,filling holes.

title: Hash Brown

items.raw: Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) ½ tsp or to taste
Kali mirch powder (Black pepper powder) 1 tsp

steps.instruction: Grate potatoes with the help of grater.
steps.romanUrdu: Aloo ko grater ki madad sa grate ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add grated potatoes in ice cold water for 10 minutes then drain and squeeze out completely with the help of muslin cloth and set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Grated aloo ko thanday pani mein 10 minutes kliya dal dein phir drain ker ka malmal ka kapray mein dal ker mukammal squeeze ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In wok,add butter and let it melt,add grated & squeeze potatoes,mix well and cook on medium flame for 4-5 minutes & let it cool down.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein makhan dal ker melt karein aur grated & squeeze aloo dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur darmiyani ancch per 4-5 minutes kliya paka lein & thanda ker lein.

steps.instruction: Now add rice flour,red chili powder,salt,onion powder,black pepper powder,corn flour and cheddar cheese,mix well and let it rest for 5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab is mein chawal ka atta,lal mirch powder,namak,onion powder,kali mirch powder,corn flour aur cheddar cheese dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 5 minutes kliya chor dein.

steps.instruction: Grease your hands with oil,take a mixture and make oval shape of equal sizes.
steps.romanUrdu: Haathon ko oil sa grease karein aur equal sizes ka oval shapes bana lein.

steps.instruction: In frying pan,heat oil and fry until golden brown.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein oil garam karein aur golden brown hunay tak fry ker lein.

title: Cake Pops

items.raw: Prepared butter cream frosting 3-4 tbs or as required

steps.instruction: In bowl,add butter and beat until fluffy.

steps.instruction: Add vanilla essence,icing sugar and beat until well combined & refrigerate until use.

steps.instruction: Crumble the cake pieces into fine crumbs with your hands in a bowl.

steps.instruction: Mix in about 3-4 tbs of prepared butter cream frosting and mix until well combined.
steps.romanUrdu: 3-4 tbs tayyar butter cream frosting dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Take a mixture and smush the mixture in your hand to pack tightly into a ball and roll it into nicely shaped balls (makes 10-12).

steps.instruction: Now dip your cake pop stick into melted cooking chocolate and quickly stick it into a cake pop and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab cake pop sticks ko melted cooking chocolate mein dip karein aur foran cake pops mein laga lein aur 30 minutes kliya refrigerate ker lein.

steps.instruction: Dip your cake pop sticks into melted cooking chocolate and coat evenly.

title: Aloo puri
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Water ¼ cup or as required

steps.instruction: In a bowl add boiled potatoes and mash them. The potatoes must be on room temperature.
steps.romanUrdu: Aek bowl main room temperature boiled aloo len aur unko mash karlen.

steps.instruction: In the mashed potatoes add all-purpose flour, sufi cooking oil, roasted and crushed cumin, salt, red chili powder, turmeric powder and fresh coriander and kneed the puri dough while gradually adding water until firm dough is formed. Leave to rest for 15 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab mashed alu main maida, sufi cooking oil, roasted and crushed zeera, namak, lal mirch powder, haldee powder aur hara dhaniya aur thore se pani se dough bana len.

steps.instruction: Grease dough with oil, cover the bowl with lid and leave the dough to rest for a few minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab dough ko oil laga kar bowl ko lid se cover karke 15 minutes rest kar len.

steps.instruction: Make small dough balls and rest for maximum 4-5 minutes and then roll them out. Make sure to keep the puri thicker from the center or it would not puff up.
steps.romanUrdu: Dough balls bana len aur unko 5 minutes rest karke poori roll out kar len. Poori ko centers se thick rakhen jese wo asani se puff up hojaye.

steps.instruction: Now deep fry the puris in properly heated oil and while frying gently press them so that they may puff up.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab inko garam sufi cooking oil main deep fry kar len aur fry karte hue ladle se press karte rahen jese wo puff up hojayen.

steps.instruction: Serve with your choice of sauces.
steps.romanUrdu: Apni pasand ki chatni k sath serve Karen.

ogDescription: Simply amazing aloo puri recipe to satisfy your cravings. #HappyCookingToYou

title: Talbina

steps.instruction: In bowl,add broken barley and wash with water.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein broken jau dal dein aur pani sad ho lein.

steps.instruction: Add water and soak for 3-4 hours or overnight then drain the water.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani dal dein aur 3-4 hours ya overnight k liya soak kerlein phir drain ker lein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add milk and bring it to boil,add soaked barley and mix well,cover partially and cook on low for 8-10 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein doodh dal ker ubal lein, soaked jau dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur partially dhak ker 8-10 minutes k liya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Deseed and chop dates.
steps.romanUrdu: Khajore ka beech nikal ker chop kerlein.

steps.instruction: Add dates,mixwell,cover partially and cook on low flame for 25-30 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Khajore dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur partially dhak ker halki ancch per 25-30 minutes k liya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add cardamom powder and mix well,cover partially and cook for another for 8-10 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Elaichi powder dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur partially dhak ker 8-10 minutes k liya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add pistachio,almonds and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Pista aur badam dal ker ache tarhan mix kerlein.

steps.instruction: Garnish & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Garnish ker ka serve karein.

title: Fry Bread
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Pani (Water) lukewarm ½ Cup or as required

steps.instruction: In bowl,add all-purpose flour,caster sugar,salt,baking powder and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein maida,bareek cheeni,namak aur baking powder dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add oil and mix.
steps.romanUrdu: Oil dal ker mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add lukewarm water and knead until dough is formed,cover and let it rest for 1 hour.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka neem garam pani shamil karein aur ghond ker dough tayyar ker lein aur dhak ker 1 hour kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Add oil and knead dough again.
steps.romanUrdu: Oil dal ker dubara ghond lein.

steps.instruction: Take a small dough and make a ball,sprinkle dry flour and rolled out with the help of rolling pin.
steps.romanUrdu: Chota dough lein aur ball bana lein,maida chirak ker rolling pin ki madad sa bail lein.

steps.instruction: Prick with fork (makes 6-8).
steps.romanUrdu: Fork ki madad sa prick ker lein (makes 6-8).

steps.instruction: In frying pan,add heat cooking oil and fry dough from both sides until golden brown.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein cooking oil garam karein aur dough ko dono sides sa golden brown hunay tak fry ker lein.

title: Pakwan
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Pani (Water) ½ Cup or as required

steps.instruction: In bowl,add all-purpose flour,semolina,ghee,salt and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein maida,sooji,ghee aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add water and knead until firm dough is formed.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur ghond ker firm dough tayyar ker lein.

steps.instruction: Cover and let it rest for 15-20 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Dhak ker 15-20 minutes kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Grease hand with oil and knead dough again until smooth.
steps.romanUrdu: Haath ko oil sa grease karein aur dough ko smooth hunay tak dubara ghond lein.

steps.instruction: Take a small dough and make a ball,sprinkle flour and roll out dough with the help of rolling pin & prick with fork (makes 7-8).
steps.romanUrdu: Chota dough lein aur ball bana lein,maida chirak ker rolling pin ki madad sa dough ko bail lein aur fork ki madad sa prick karein (makes 7-8).

steps.instruction: In wok,heat cooking oil and fry until golden & crispy.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein cooking oil garam karein aur golden & crispy hunay tak fry ker lein.
